title: Rules RMUnite Tutorial s - Rules and Guidelines

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
RMUnite Tutorials — Rules and Guidelines
(Last Update: March 20th, 2025)
​
Threads posted in the RMUnite Tutorials board
will enter a moderation queue
and will not appear until it is accepted by a moderator. Threads will be accepted or denied based on how well they meet the rules and guidelines. Give at least 72 hours before inquiring about the state of your thread and address all concerns with a moderator.
When posting in the RMUnite Tutorials board you are expected to read, understand, and meet the minimum requirements to post a new thread in this forum.
Remember:
All non-English tutorials must be translated.
This is the official English forums and everyone is required to interact in English. If your tutorial is entirely in another language it will not be accepted.
Your tutorial must be clear and concise. Your tutorial must be well written.
Your screenshots must indicate a legal and unmodified copy of Unite is being used.
Template for posting a tutorial
​
Tutorial topic:
(Ex: How to edit sprites.)
Brief description:
Add a sentence or two describing what you will be discussing. (Ex: We will look at how to recolor sprites and ‘frankenstein’ multiple sprites together to create a new look.)
Requirements:
List any required programs, add-ons, background knowledge, etc that will be necessary to the tutorial. (Ex: GIMP, Photoshop, Paint.net, or other image editing program that supports transparency.)
Tutorial body:
Here is where you will put the details of your tutorial. Please write clearly, in English, and include necessary details. Screenshots are great, particularly in the case of complicated event tutorials. Do not simply post a link to a tutorial written elsewhere, though you may share one at the end of your tutorial.
If sharing a video tutorial, this is where you’d share your video in lieu of written instructions.
Tags:
Providing tags will help members find your tutorial more easily.
Please also remember
​
The tutorial must be for RPG Maker Unite games.
No other exceptions. There are specific sections for tutorials of each engine.
This is not a forum for support questions
. The other board,
RPG Maker Unite
, is for that.
Wait 24 hours before bumping your thread
to give an equal chance to other members and their tutorial threads. As always, spamming will not be tolerated!
Remember to read our General Rules before posting.
Exceptions to this rule will be accepted on a per thread basis.
Contact a moderator for any other inquiries.
